purpose: Assess historical communication-frame selection without presuming editorial intent, cognitive effect, or cognitive warfare.

attribution.original_scientific_reply: James E. Hansen, The Washington Post letter (8 June 1993)
attribution.original_gcc_communications: John Shlaes/Global Climate Coalition, 30 June response; GCC Climate Watch Vol 1 Issue 9
attribution.theoretical_perspectives: Retain individual original author ownership (Peirce, Hall, Mulvey, Barthes, etc.) when directly cited; none are co-authors of this coding protocol.
attribution.formal_method: DASHI CCDCOE P3 source-indexed mechanism discrimination and selective reopening; not a substitute for empirical validation.

unit_of_analysis: An original bounded passage, with exact source, edition, stable text range and independently established original author/quoted speaker. Media item != quotation != exposure.

uncertainty.rule: Only code how uncertainty is expressed in cited passages, not whether the scientific claim is correct; source quote attribution must remain distinct from reporter framing.

scientific_voice.rule: Identifies credited speaker and whether source text includes a response or competing interpretation. Multiple voices require separate units.

risk_time_horizon.rule: Do not infer risk horizon from positive/negative valence alone.

agency.rule: Textual invitation for epistemic revision; NOT actual audience capacity or behaviour.

selective_reuse.rule: Requires both original passage and independently reviewed derivative original text; archival summary alone must be undeterminable.

coder_protocol.adjudication: Keep initial independent scores, adjudicated score and disagreement/residual separately; never erase previous observations.
coder_protocol.reliability: Report raw agreement and Cohen kappa for each dimension; if expected agreement=1, report kappa null and insufficient variation, never convert to 1.
coder_protocol.sample: Predeclare full eligible source-item frame and selection denominator; archive clippings do not constitute exhaustive outlet sample.

comparison_design.primary_contrast: Rensberger's attributed original article vs original GCC 30 June communication and Sep bulletin if independently reviewed
negative_controls: Hansen original 8 June rebuttal already public before 30 June GCC communication: availability != GCC knowledge.
Original article precedes 30 June GCC response, which cannot cause that earlier article.
Reporter and quoted scientists are separate voices and source authors.
Later GCC bulletin highlighting an article establishes secondary reference, not original news placement.
comparison_design.required_causal_design: Original distribution/exposure, baseline, controls and sensitivity; source-only comparisons cannot identify audience belief change.
comparison_design.intent_standard: Separate original attribution, targeting, coordination and alleged hostile objective from evidence of selective messaging.
